dreamteamer.title: Recordings
dreamteamer.description: One captured audio file and its transcript per `meeting-recordings` record — pulled out of `${env:INBOX_FOLDERS}` by content hash, filed under `${env:FILES_FOLDER}`, matched to its meeting, transcribed offline (faster-whisper + diarisation, Hebrew and English), with the screenshots taken during the call filed beside it. Carries the transcript-gated bindings of the meeting pipeline (summarise · extract tasks · analyse), because those are only possible once a transcript exists. Depends on `meetings`.
